title: Removing embedded points lowers the support dimension of the kernel
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. There is a coherent subsheaf $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal F$ whose support is nowhere dense in $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ such that, for $\mathcal F'=\mathcal F/\mathcal K$, the supports of $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal F'$ agree, $\mathcal F'$ has no embedded associated points, and $\dim(\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal K))<\dim(\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F))$ when the latter dimension is finite and positive.
